rationale: This additive post-Mission-5 Experience integration and corrective follow-up implement existing presentation and contract-consumption duties without changing constitutional meaning. Conclave creation is independently gated and create-only: it preserves and selects the durable canonical workspace with a stable run-pending identity even when the distinct run action is unavailable; only the explicit, separately run-gated control can dispatch that exact run, and terminal success requires the canonical receipt-backed verification predicate. Realtime response timeout in Voice and Copilot now stages the captured transcript and stable idempotency identity only in private component state, performs zero governed Voice POSTs until the operator clicks the explicit text-action-gated control, preserves unrelated editable composer text, and reuses one key without duplicating user history across ambiguous retries. Project, Document, Work Session, Mission, Knowledge, Edge, and baseline draft mutations use the same executable private snapshot, attempt, retain-on-failure, and clear-on-success lifecycle where their gateway contract supports idempotency; Copilot HIF text remains visible and disabled in flight and clears only after a durable interaction identity because that contract exposes no truthful browser idempotency seam. Every unavailable portable client projection, including symmetric desktop/web states, must exactly match an exhaustive module/client/basis evidence catalog whose repo paths and authoritative headings or symbols are resolved by tests; implementation absence, circular registry references, opaque strings, and generic unmatched evidence fail closed. Operational Replay remains passive, browser persistence remains limited to color-mode preference, and no Runtime truth, Authority, completion claim, deployment, production-readiness claim, Mission 6 work, or accepted Mission history or receipt is created or mutated.
